content.Title: 2017 High Blood Pressure Clinical Practice Guideline
content.Introduction: This guideline focuses on the management and treatment of high blood pressure with various recommendations on measurement and monitoring.
content.4. Measurement of BP: The section discusses methods of accurate measurement of blood pressure in various settings including in-office and out-of-office monitoring.
content.4.1. Accurate Measurement of BP in the O: Includes guidelines from different health organizations on in-office blood pressure measurement. Emphasizes the importance of risk assessment and prevention.
content.4.2. Out-of-Office and Self-Monitoring o: Guidelines for self-monitoring of blood pressure, including comparative effectiveness and recommendations for ambulatory monitoring.
content.4.3. Ambulatory BP Monitoring: Highlights recommendations for when ambulatory monitoring is most beneficial and reimbursement policies.
content.4.4. Manufacturer\u2019s Documentation: The guideline provides insights into educational resources and equipment for blood pressure monitoring.
